name: Public Health — Vaccine Mandate
description: A mandatory vaccination program during an outbreak splits citizens, doctors, and liberty advocates.
seed_text: A country rolls out a mandatory vaccination program for all adults during an outbreak. Many citizens support it to protect the vulnerable. A vocal minority opposes it, citing personal freedom. Healthcare workers are exhausted but mostly supportive. A top doctor urged everyone to get vaccinated "for the common good". A civil-liberties lawyer criticized the mandate as government overreach. Religious groups and skeptics spread doubt online, and protests are growing.
